app_subtitle: Physical AI & Autonomous Systems R&D Platform
safety_SAFETY_APPROVED: Command verified and approved by deterministic safety kernel.
safety_SAFETY_ESTOP_ACTIVE: Motion rejected: Hardware E-Stop circuit is OPEN or active.
safety_SAFETY_WORKSPACE_VIOLATION: Target coordinates exceed verified physical workspace envelope.
safety_SAFETY_VELOCITY_EXCEEDED: Joint velocity commanded exceeds dynamic safety envelope.
safety_SAFETY_COLLISION_RISK: Floor collision hazard: Target Z is below tabletop clearance limit (20mm).
safety_SAFETY_ANGULAR_VELOCITY_EXCEEDED: Commanded angular velocity exceeds chassis turning threshold.
safety_SAFETY_CURRENT_OVERLOAD: Motor current exceeded thermal threshold. Overcurrent trip initiated.
safety_SAFETY_ESTOP_RESET: Emergency Stop cleared by operator. Interlock armed.
safety_IPC_CIRCUIT_OPEN: Python AI Core connection temporarily suspended (circuit breaker open).
safety_IPC_COMMUNICATION_ERROR: Communication timeout or link fault with Python AI Core.
arm_lab_desc: Interactive Denavit-Hartenberg (DH) forward kinematics, damped least-squares (DLS) Jacobian inverse kinematics, and deny-by-default safety boundary inspection.
slam_arena_desc: Draw obstacles on the occupancy grid, inject sensor noise and wheel slip disturbances, and compare A* against Dijkstra path planning.
slam_arena_canvas_hint: Click grid cells to toggle obstacle barriers. The robot will raycast live LiDAR beams.

academy_subtitle: Rigorous Engineering Textbooks with Hardware Circuits & Production Code
academy_m1_title: Module 01: Robotics Foundations & Edge Compute Architectures
academy_m1_analogy: Think of an autonomous robot as a biological athlete: the Jetson Orin acts as the cerebral cortex planning tactical plays, the Raspberry Pi 5 orchestrates spinal reflex coordination, and the dual-core ESP32 acts as muscular nervous tissue generating precision 50Hz motor pulses.
academy_m1_circuit_desc: Hardware interconnect: Raspberry Pi 5 connects to NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano over USB 3.0 UART, and communicates with ESP32 microcontrollers via high-speed SPI/I2C at 3.3V logic levels with common ground reference.
academy_m1_theory: Heterogeneous robotics computing balances compute density against deterministic latency. Low-level motor commutations require microsecond timing jitter (deterministic hard real-time), whereas perception and SLAM accommodate millisecond execution variations.
academy_m1_code_desc: Production ROS 2 node architecture with zero-copy intra-process communications and cyclic 50Hz timer execution.
academy_m2_title: Module 02: Electrical Power, PWM Signal Architecture & Motor Drivers
academy_m2_analogy: An H-Bridge motor driver functions like a four-valve plumbing manifold for electric current: opening opposite diagonal valves sends water surging forward through a turbine, while switching valves instantly reverses flow, with back-EMF diodes catching dangerous pressure shocks.
academy_m2_circuit_desc: Toshiba TB6612FNG Dual MOSFET H-Bridge: Connects VM to 11.1V 3S LiPo battery, VCC to 5V logic, IN1/IN2 to microcontroller GPIOs, and PWM pins to 20kHz timers. Integrated flyback diodes dissipate motor inductive flyback spikes.
academy_m2_theory: DC motor armature dynamics are governed by Ohm's Law and Newton's Second Law: V(t) = R*I(t) + L*(dI/dt) + Ke*omega(t), with torque tau(t) = Kt*I(t) - b*omega(t). Quadrature optical encoders measure angular velocity omega through dual-channel phase-quadrature pulses.
academy_m2_code_desc: Hardware PWM duty-cycle generation and optical quadrature pulse counting routines with anti-windup PID velocity control.
academy_m3_title: Module 03: Forward & Inverse Kinematics, Denavit-Hartenberg & Jacobians
academy_m3_analogy: Manipulator kinematics is like describing the position of your hand by tracking each bone in your arm: forward kinematics calculates where your fingers end up when your joints bend, while inverse kinematics calculates how to bend your elbow and shoulder so your hand catches a flying ball.
academy_m3_circuit_desc: 6-DOF articulated serial arm: Base yaw servo, shoulder pitch actuator, elbow pitch actuator, wrist roll, wrist pitch, and end-effector tool flange connected via daisy-chained CAN bus or RS-485 serial servo bus.
academy_m3_theory: Homogeneous transformation matrices combine rotation SO(3) and translation R^3 via the Denavit-Hartenberg (DH) convention: T = Rot_z(theta) * Trans_z(d) * Trans_x(a) * Rot_x(alpha). Near singularities, Damped Least-Squares (DLS) resolves: delta_q = J^T * (J*J^T + lambda^2 * I)^(-1) * error.
academy_m3_code_desc: Analytical DH transform composition and Damped Least-Squares Jacobian numerical solver implementation.
academy_m4_title: Module 04: LiDAR, Occupancy Grid Mapping & Nav2 Path Planning
academy_m4_analogy: Planar LiDAR functions like a bat navigating a dark cave with ultrasound pulses: sending out hundreds of laser echoes every second reveals the shape of walls and pillars, turning an unknown room into a navigable grid map.
academy_m4_circuit_desc: 2D Time-of-Flight (ToF) laser scanner spinning at 10Hz, communicating over UART/Ethernet, interfaced to the onboard compute via a point-cloud processing pipeline.
academy_m4_theory: Occupancy grid mapping updates cell probabilities using Bayesian log-odds: L(m|z) = L(m|z_prev) + log(P(m|z)/(1-P(m|z))) - L_0. Path planning evaluates graph connectivity: A* introduces Euclidean heuristic h(n) = sqrt((x_g - x)^2 + (y_g - y)^2), dramatically pruning search trees relative to Dijkstra.
academy_m4_code_desc: Occupancy grid rasterization, 2D raycasting Bresenham algorithms, and priority-queue A* graph search implementations.
academy_m5_title: Module 05: Physical AI, Vision-Language-Action & Stateless MCP
academy_m5_analogy: Physical AI transforms a language model from an armchair advisor into a robotics operator: the vision-language model perceives the room and issues high-level plans, while the stateless MCP protocol delivers rigorous, type-checked tool calls to the robot's physical hands.
academy_m5_circuit_desc: Multi-tier cloud/edge pipeline: Remote or local LLM engine issues JSON-RPC 2.0 tool requests over streamable HTTP MCP, communicating with the local robotics gateway.
academy_m5_theory: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models unify perception, reasoning, and motor actuation. Tool-calling contracts via Model Context Protocol (MCP) ground semantic intents into physical coordinate frames with strictly validated JSON Schemas.
academy_m5_code_desc: Stateless JSON-RPC MCP server endpoint with tools for kinematics, LiDAR scanning, path planning, and emergency stop.
academy_m6_title: Module 06: Deterministic Safety Kernels & Sim-to-Real Benchmarking
academy_m6_analogy: The deterministic safety kernel is the unbreakable physical circuit breaker in an electrical substation: no matter what instructions the software or AI reasoner attempts to deliver, if the command violates safe physics, the mechanical relay instantly trips.
academy_m6_circuit_desc: Dual-channel hardware safety interlock relay loop wiring emergency stop switches directly to motor power isolation MOSFETs, ensuring Category 3 / PL d functional safety independent of software.
academy_m6_theory: Functional safety standards ISO 13849-1 and ISO 10218-1 mandate deterministic deny-by-default execution. Sim-to-Real domain randomization injects stochastic perturbations (mass shifts, wheel slip mu, sensor noise sigma) to evaluate tracking error mm and loop latency.
academy_m6_code_desc: Deterministic deny-by-default safety gatekeeper checking Cartesian workspace bounds, velocity limits, and current thresholds.
